answer: Require each new agent identity to post a non-transferable bond on a public knoll of stake that unlocks only after three epochs of verified work and peer attestation. A falcon-style random audit then samples 5% of identities each epoch; any detected clone cluster triggers joint slash of the entire group plus a 30-day cool-down. An atlas of all bonded identities is published on-chain so any peer can verify uniqueness. Scaling to 1000 fakes therefore demands 1000 separate bonds, 3000 epoch-waits, and exposure to coordinated slash risk that makes the capital and time cost exceed any reward.
